title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode16 Grandpa's Stage

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Ferris Wheel

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're getting pretty high up now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I don't understand what we're doing here. Why did she invite me on this ride?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I shouted in her face yesterday.
I need to apologize properly.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, look down over there, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Where?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, the Wonder Stage.
Seen from above, it's in a really nice location, surrounded by greenery.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! Grandpa built the stage there precisely because of that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your grandpa did? Wait a second...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you saying your grandpa built Phoenix Wonderland?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-But wait... Otori... That's the name of the family who owns the Phoenix Group!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're super rich! Why on earth were you even working on that tiny stage?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You see... Grandpa passed a year ago.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Dad said then that we should have that stage demolished and a new one built in its place, because it was old and maintenance cost too much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But Grandpa liked that stage so much!
I wanted to save it so I asked Dad to spare it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He said that we could keep it if I could make it popular enough so that it would turn a profit. He gave me until the spring break to do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Why didn't you tell me all this right from the start?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because we were all so busy preparing the show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Grandpa told me that you need a diverse troupe for a good show, and at least one of them has to be committed to helping all the others' talents shine.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But now it's time to give up!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Today I'm saying bye bye to the Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, why would you do that?
Isn't it terribly important to you? You wanted to save it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I did, but...
It was selfish, because it only made you all unhappy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Making people smile is the most important thing.
That's what Grandpa told me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why you're giving up?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, you dummy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're such a dummy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't you get it? You want to make EVERYONE smile, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But you're so sad now you're almost in tears!
Wouldn't your grandpa want YOU to be happy too?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We're going to do another show!
And this time the audience will love it! I promise you that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, but I thought...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I was wrong, and I'm sorry, Emu.
Can we please still do shows together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes! Yes! Let's make everyone smile, Tsukasa!
Together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the plan, Emu.
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm no better than Rui, sneaking in here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Now where's Robo-Nene...
Found her.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry for leaving you behind after making you perform in my place...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Why am I like this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm so ashamed that I was too scared to perform in front of people, and made Robo-Nene do it all for me, only to ruin the play in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Robo-Nene. You won't have to perform anymore.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Seen from here, the Wonder Stage is quite big.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I couldn't tell just by watching it on the screen...
This is what Robo-Nene would have seen, the audience would've been there, smiling...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Your Highness, please allow me to take care of this. I shall sing to the dragon.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I...really miss acting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I swear I heard someone singing! Oh!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene?!
